jwtSecretBanner.label: JWT_SECRET is weak.
jwtSecretBanner.detail: It is a published placeholder or too predictable, so session tokens can be forged. Generate a strong one with openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it stops authenticator codes from working and forgets trusted devices: users sign in with a backup code and set up 2FA again, and you reset 2FA in User Management for anyone without one. Read docs/backend/modules-and-runtime.md (Changing JWT_SECRET) first.
